MAILER_DSN is the shipped default null://null. It reports every message as sent and delivers none, so verification and password-reset email will silently vanish.

The SMTP host accepted a connection. That proves it is reachable and willing to talk, not that it will accept or deliver your mail.

MAILER_FROM_ADDRESS is still on the placeholder domain localhost. Real mail servers reject it, and email verification is mandatory, so nobody can finish registering. Set it to an address on a domain you control.
Mail is sent as %address%. Deliverability also needs SPF, DKIM and DMARC published for that domain.
